description: This file is a shell script implementing various utility functions for downloading and managing application updates/downloads in a device management context. It includes functions for URL retrieval, download attempts with retries, handling of download blocking mechanisms, and extraction of downloaded archives.

methods.name: getJSONValue
methods.description: Retrieves a value from a JSON query using jsonquery utility

methods.name: getJSONArraySize
methods.description: Gets the size of a JSON array using jsonquery utility

methods.name: get_core_value
methods.description: Determines whether the device CPU core is ARM or ATOM based on /tmp/cpu_info or cpuinfo

methods.name: downloadApp_getFWVersion
methods.description: Extracts firmware version from /version.txt based on predefined tags

methods.name: downloadApp_getBuildType
methods.description: Determines build type (VBN, PROD, QA, DEV, etc.) from firmware version

methods.name: downloadApp_getVersionPrefix
methods.description: Generates a version prefix by removing build type suffix from firmware version

methods.name: getDownloadUrl
methods.description: Retrieves the download URL from various configured sources and applies URL adjustments

methods.name: IsDirectBlocked
methods.description: Checks if direct download attempts are blocked based on last failure timestamp

methods.name: IsCodeBigBlocked
methods.description: Checks if codebig download attempts are blocked based on last failure timestamp

methods.name: get_Codebigconfig
methods.description: Retrieves configuration info for codebig fallback and connection strategy

methods.name: getCodebigUrl
methods.description: Generates a signed URL and OAuth header for codebig download requests

methods.name: generateDownloadUrl
methods.description: Prepares the download URL and command for either direct or codebig download

methods.name: sendDownloadRequest
methods.description: Performs the actual download request using curl, with retries and error handling

methods.name: sendAppDownloadRequest
methods.description: Performs an app-level download request, handling response and errors

methods.name: applicationDownload
methods.description: Manages the process of downloading a file, with support for retries, codebig, and direct download modes

methods.name: applicationExtraction
methods.description: Extracts a downloaded archive to specified location

methods.name: is_file_exists
methods.description: Checks if a file exists and outputs its basename
